model_system: URu2Si2 hidden-order phase modeled as a field-induced chiral dxy + i dx2-y2 spin-density wave on a 2D lattice with ordering vector Q=(pi,pi)

key_params.order_parameter: Delta^z(k)=Delta1 sin(kx) sin(ky) - i Delta2 (cos kx - cos ky)
key_params.peak_Nernst_experiment_target: 30 microV/K at B≈12 T and T≈3–4 K

headline_claim: Self-consistent mean-field theory reproduces the URu2Si2 field-temperature phase diagram with double-step metamagnetic transitions at 33.5 T and about 41 T, and explains the giant positive Nernst signal reaching about 30 microV/K near 12 T and 3–4 K.
replication_difficulty: medium — requires solving coupled field- and temperature-dependent gap equations and transport from reconstructed quasiparticle bands, but no ab initio input is needed.
